ttnn_argmax.verdict: SELECTED — semantically greedy, no cross-device movement, tile-shaped.

sampling_1d_tttv2.verdict: REJECTED for greedy: expects per-device vocab shards and all-gathers over dim=3 (cluster_shape=[1,4]); Kokoro's readout is a tiny (178) REPLICATED vocab, so the gather would concat 4 identical copies and add movement for no benefit. Retained as the top-k/top-p path if sampled TTS-token selection is ever needed (vocab is tiny so it can run single-device on a (1,1) submesh).

tt_sampling_tttv1.verdict: REJECTED for greedy: same contract as TTTv2 (requires vocab sharded across the mesh cluster axis + cross-device all-gather, needs args.cluster_shape/tt_ccl and a SamplingGenerator wrapper). Heavier than TTTv2 for our tiny replicated vocab; TTTv2 is the lighter of the two if a sampled path is needed.
